name: claudecode-workspace
description: Team workspace WebUI for a server-resident Claude Code — per-session isolation + shared rooms + code-server.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.compose:up: docker compose up -d --build && docker image prune -f
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch -m "chore(release): v%s" && node scripts/release.mjs
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor -m "chore(release): v%s" && node scripts/release.mjs
scripts.release:major: npm version major -m "chore(release): v%s" && node scripts/release.mjs
